        {"variable": "x1", "unit": "G1", "output_kW": 60, "operational_cost": 8, "equipment": "inverter_bank_A"},

        {"variable": "x4", "unit": "G4", "output_kW": 30, "operational_cost": 4, "equipment": "independent"},
        {"variable": "x5", "unit": "G5", "output_kW": 20, "operational_cost": 6, "equipment": "diesel_manifold_B"},
        {"variable": "x6", "unit": "G6", "output_kW": 35, "operational_cost": 7, "equipment": "diesel_manifold_B"},
        {"variable": "x7", "unit": "G7", "output_kW": 15, "operational_cost": 2, "equipment": "independent"},
    ]

    # Define the constraints
    constraints = [
        {"type": "demand_coverage", "expression": "60*x1 + 40*x2 + 25*x3 + 30*x4 + 20*x5 + 35*x6 + 15*x7 >= 80", "description": "Total activated generation must meet or exceed 80 kW campus demand."},
        {"type": "equipment_conflict", "expression": "x1 * x2 == 0", "description": "G1 and G2 share the same DC-AC inverter bank (inverter_bank_A) and cannot both be activated simultaneously."},
        {"type": "equipment_conflict", "expression": "x5 * x6 == 0", "description": "G5 and G6 share the same diesel fuel manifold (diesel_manifold_B) and cannot both run at the same time."},
    ]

    # Construct the QUBO model
    qubo = dimod.QubitAssignment.from_expr(
        "60*x1 + 40*x2 + 25*x3 + 30*x4 + 20*x5 + 35*x6 + 15*x7 - 80"
    )

    # Add penalty terms for equipment conflicts
    qubo.add_quad_term(-1 * x1 * x2)
    qubo.add_quad_term(-1 * x5 * x6)

    # Solve the QUBO using COBYLA optimizer
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=100)
    solution = optimizer.solve(qubo)

    # Extract the optimal solution
    optimal_assignment = solution.x
    
    # Calculate the total cost and total output
    total_cost = 0
    total_output = 0
    for i in range(num_variables):
        if optimal_assignment[i] == 1:
            total_cost += resources[i]["operational_cost"] * 1
            total_output += resources[i]["output_kW"]

    # Calculate feasibility quality and constraint violation rate
    feasible_objective_quality = total_cost / 10  # Assuming optimal cost is 10
    constraint_violation_rate = 0
    if total_output < 80:
        constraint_violation_rate = 1

    # Return the results
    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": total_cost,
        "runtime": 0.1,  # Placeholder runtime
        "evaluation_cost": 0.01,  # Placeholder evaluation cost
        "achieved_cost": total_cost,
        "activated_units": [i + 1 for i, x in enumerate(optimal_assignment) if x == 1],
        "total_output_kw": total_output,
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    results = solve_microgrid_dispatch()
    print(results)
